purpose: Candidate validation evidence, not a calibrated target set or fitted result.

observations.source_anchor: Lower-right ridership tile; bottom-left as-of date
limitations: Counting convention must be reconciled with simulated boardings or linked journeys.
A calendar-month total is not a weekday mean or station-hour distribution.
Other tiles on the image are cumulative or promotional and are not monthly patronage.
observations.transcription_method: Visual operator image or published PDF text checked against the labelled table; no extrapolation

observations.source_anchor: PDF page 1, CONTAINER TOTAL (TEUs), Aug-2026 monthly column
limitations: Publication is provisional as of 1 September 2026.
TEUs are neither containers, trucks, rakes nor wagon counts.
Road, rail, transshipment and coastal shares need separate observations.
observations.transcription_method: Visual operator image or published PDF text checked against the labelled table; no extrapolation

observations.source_anchor: Container movement by Rail; ICD traffic table, NO. OF Rakes, 2025-26 column
limitations: The unit is the operator-reported rake; loaded/empty and arrival/departure counting definitions remain to be reconciled.
An annual total does not supply daily departure times, terminal paths, train lengths or section occupancy.

observations.source_anchor: Page 1, paragraph on first and last-mile connectivity: 'Currently serving over 3.5 lakh daily passengers on Metro Lines 2A and 7'
limitations: 'Over 3.5 lakh' is a rounded lower bound, not a counted day.
The counting convention (entries, journeys) is not stated; MMRDA's OGD daily series (ogd_metro_2a_7_ridership_daily_2024_2025) is the counted series once acquired.

observations.source_anchor: Page 71, 'Unparalleled Ridership and Network Synergy': 'having served over 1,101 million passengers as of April 30, 2025'
limitations: A cumulative total since June 2014; the daily figure is the operator's performance page (metro1_ridership_july_2026).
